recorded.note: recorded from the frozen Phase 8 output as registered (s. 8); not recomputed here. The S(i) observability rank is dropped.

days.note: the registered D is every scored day; the statistics of s. 4 are undefined on a day with no daylight step and average over the with_daylight set (see `partition_days`)

prediction.magnitude: 0.5 * R * P / V^2 p.u. at buses downstream of the stressed line
prediction.shape: monotone in downstream PV x R, with the argmax downstream of the stressed line
prediction.night_sign: HYPOTHESIS: the night residual has the opposite sign to the daylight one
prediction.rule: any contradiction is reported as a contradiction, not reconciled

1-LV-semiurb4--2-sw.thresholds_note: `thresholds` are the registered ones (D = every scored day). `thresholds_with_daylight_days` repeat the same formulas over the days the estimator can average; reported for transparency, not a registered verdict. Both sets are fixed in Stage 1, before any vm array is loaded.
